title: Why Bihar is a FAILED State?
description:
Bihar should have been one of India’s strongest states—rich in culture, talent, and history. Instead, it’s stuck in a cycle of corruption, poor infrastructure, and political apathy.

From bridges collapsing within days of inauguration to funds disappearing in “pond chori” and road scams, Bihar’s governance has become a joke. Corrupt leaders and lazy bureaucrats keep looting public money while citizens suffer from bad roads, weak education, and zero job opportunities.

In this video, we expose how Bihar’s development story is being written in lies and loot—and why the people deserve better.
